design_intent:
MiniRV Edge Controller reference journey.
Compare one fixed RTL design across supported iCE40 and ECP5 targets at 75 MHz. The dual-read 16x32 register bank, 32-bit ALU, multiplier, sensor accumulator, UART, timer, interrupt logic, and four PWM channels are intentionally substantial enough to create a meaningful multi-board utilization and timing comparison.
frequency_relaxation_policy: reported only for candidates that fail the requested target after closure

best_for_growth.label: Lattice OrangeCrab ECP5-85F
best_for_growth.next_step: Continue to FPGA Prototyping to apply verified board pins, rerun implementation, verify, and generate the bitstream.
best_for_growth.why: Meets 20 MHz with 157.9% timing margin and 95.1% logic headroom.

best_low_cost.label: Lattice iCE40 HX8K Breakout
best_low_cost.next_step: Continue to FPGA Prototyping to apply verified board pins, rerun implementation, verify, and generate the bitstream.
best_low_cost.why: Meets 20 MHz with 61.9% timing margin and 27.4% logic headroom.

best_overall.label: Lattice CrossLink-NX Evaluation Board (LIFCL-40)
best_overall.next_step: Continue to FPGA Prototyping to apply verified board pins, rerun implementation, verify, and generate the bitstream.
best_overall.why: Meets 20 MHz with 382.4% timing margin and 91.7% logic headroom.

best_performance.label: Lattice CrossLink-NX Evaluation Board (LIFCL-40)
best_performance.next_step: Continue to FPGA Prototyping to apply verified board pins, rerun implementation, verify, and generate the bitstream.
best_performance.why: Meets 20 MHz with 382.4% timing margin and 91.7% logic headroom.

recommendation_policy.best_low_cost: smallest viable FPGA capacity proxy; live board pricing is not assumed
recommendation_policy.best_overall: target met, timing stability, useful headroom, performance, then smallest viable target
